```{r}
#| label: est-multi
ests <- est_seroincidence_by_cached(
  pop_data = sim_df,
  sr_params = sim_curve_params,
  noise_params = sim_noise_params,
  strata = c("sample_size", "lambda.sim", "cluster"),
  curve_strata_varnames = NULL,
  noise_strata_varnames = NULL,
  antigen_isos = antibodies,
  # Graphs are attached per stratum, which would make the cached object
  # enormous for this many strata. The few curves this article plots are
  # re-fit on demand instead.
  build_graph = FALSE,
  cache_path = sim_cache,
  cache_id = "ests"
)

ests_summary <- ests |> summary()
```

::: notes
`summary()` returns a `tibble()` carrying some extra metadata about the
stratification.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ests-summary
if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  ests_summary |>
    DT::datatable(options = list(scrollX = TRUE)) |>
    DT::formatRound(
      columns = c("incidence.rate", "SE", "CI.lwr", "CI.upr", "log.lik")
    )
} else {
  ests_summary
}
```

::: notes
The interactive table is HTML-only; other formats print the plain summary,
since converting the widget to a static image would need a headless browser.
:::
